templateVersions.content: Data : {!$Flow:Negative_Meeting_Notes_Collection.Prompt} **Context:**   You are tasked with analyzing the negative customer meeting notes regarding our company’s products.   These meeting notes contain textual comments on the negative aspects of the products and customer perception ratings (1-5).   **Objective:**   The goal is to identify and rank key negative themes for each product, providing valuable insights to the sales team.   This will help refine sales strategies and inform future business planning by addressing objections and improving products.   **Instructions:**   **Reading the Notes:**   1. Carefully review the provided customer meeting notes with negative sentiment.   2. Identify the covered period by noting the oldest and most recent dates in the meeting notes: Period: [{oldest_meeting_date} - {most_recent_meeting_date}]   **Identifying Themes:**   1. Summarize the main negative points for each product.   2. Rank these themes in descending order of occurrence.   3. For each theme, provide the following:      - A concise description of the theme in 200 characters.      - An example comment that illustrates the theme, including the meeting note record reference or link.      - The number of occurrences of this theme in the notes.   **Structuring the Results:**   1. List the top 5 recurring themes.   **Sales Strategy Insights:**   1. Suggest concrete actions the sales team can take to address the negative feedback.   2. Identify potential objections and provide counterarguments.   **Output Format:**   (Ensure all parts from Start Format to End Format are fully completed.)   ``` Product: [Product Name]   Period: [oldest meeting date - most recent meeting date]   The number of Client Interest for this product during the period: [number]   Average Score for the product on the period: [Average Score of the product]   Negative Points:   #1 - Percentage% (number meeting notes) - [Main Negative Theme 1]   Concise description in 200 characters of negative comments on this theme.   Example of customer comment: "[Most relevant and/or most recent verbatim related to this theme]" & Meeting Note   #2 - [Repeat format for additional points up to #5]   Sales Strategy Insights:   - Summarize key actions for the sales team to address the negative feedback.   - Identify potential objections and provide counterarguments.   ```
